definition_zh: 尴尬的；笨拙的；难使用的；难对付的
definition_en: causing embarrassment; clumsy; hard to use or handle
core_image: 手不知道往哪放的那一刻：身子和场面都不听使唤
scene: 新人把咖啡泼在了面试官桌上，会议室瞬间安静。He gave an awkward smile and apologized.
sceneCN: 这里 awkward 指「尴尬的」（第 1 个义项：令人难堪的场面感）；句意：他尴尬地笑了笑并道歉。

senses.title: Causing embarrassment
senses.definition: making people feel uncomfortable or ashamed
senses.definitionCN: 使人感到不自在或难堪的
senses.example: There was an awkward pause after his joke.
senses.exampleCN: 他讲完笑话后是一阵尴尬的冷场。
senses.why: The core image is a body turned the wrong way; social misfit extends that wrongness to a scene.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是身子拧反了；社交上的不合拍把这种「别扭」延伸到整个场面。

senses.title: Clumsy in movement
senses.definition: moving in an ungraceful or uncontrolled way
senses.example: The colt was still awkward on its long legs.
senses.exampleCN: 小马驹腿长，走路还踉踉跄跄。
senses.why: The Old Norse root meant turned backwards; limbs that turn the wrong way look clumsy.
senses.whyCN: 古诺斯语词根本义「朝后的」；肢体转错方向便显得笨拙。

senses.title: Hard to use or hold
senses.definition: difficult to handle because of shape, size, or design
senses.definitionCN: 因形状、大小或设计而难以拿放操作的
senses.example: The freezer has an awkward shape for a small kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 这台冰柜形状别扭，小厨房放不下。
senses.why: A thing turned the wrong way for your hand resists easy use.
senses.whyCN: 对使用者来说「方向不对」的东西，自然用不顺手。

senses.title: Hard to deal with
senses.definition: difficult to deal with or manage, as a person or situation
senses.definitionCN: 指人或局面难以应付、难以处理
senses.example: The witness proved awkward under cross-examination.
senses.exampleCN: 这位证人在交叉盘问下极难对付。
senses.why: What sits the wrong way in a system cannot be fitted in or managed smoothly.
senses.whyCN: 在系统里「位置不正」的东西，无法被顺当地安放或处理。

senses.title: Embarrassed in manner
senses.definitionCN: 感到或表现出难为情、不自在
senses.example: She felt awkward about accepting the gift.
senses.exampleCN: 收下这份礼物让她觉得不自在。
senses.why: When your inner posture turns the wrong way, it shows as self-consciousness.
senses.whyCN: 内在姿态「转错了方向」，外显出来便是自我意识过强的局促。

senses.title: Inconveniently timed or placed
senses.definition: inconvenient because of timing or placement
senses.definitionCN: 因时间或位置不巧而带来不便的
senses.example: The meeting falls at an awkward hour for us.
senses.exampleCN: 会议定的时间对我们很不巧。
senses.why: A slot turned the wrong way against your schedule is simply inconvenient.
senses.whyCN: 时段与日程「拧着来」，便构成不便。

senses.title: Awkward squad and phrases
senses.definition: not fitting a required pattern, as in the awkward squad
senses.definitionCN: 指不合既定队形或规矩的人，如 the awkward squad
senses.example: He was posted to the awkward squad of difficult recruits.
senses.exampleCN: 他被分进了难管新兵组成的「捣蛋队」。
senses.why: The one who stands the wrong way in line becomes the type of the nonconformer.
senses.whyCN: 队列里站错方向的人，成了不守规矩者的典型。

senses.title: The adverbial phrase awkwardly
senses.definition: in an uncomfortable, ungraceful, or embarrassed way
senses.definitionCN: 以不自在、不优美或难堪的方式
senses.example: He shifted awkwardly in his seat.
senses.exampleCN: 他在座位上局促地挪来挪去。
senses.why: Adding -ly turns the wrong-turned posture into a manner of acting.
senses.whyCN: 加 -ly 后把「拧转的姿态」变成行事的方式。

intro.en: Awkward comes from Old Norse afugr, turned the wrong way, joined to English -ward: something facing backward, then someone acting backward.
intro.cn: awkward 由古诺斯语 afugr「朝后的、反转的」加英语 -ward 构成：先是「方向朝后之物」，再引申为「举止别扭之人」。

items.en: afugr meant turned backwards or perverse.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 afugr 意为「朝后的、悖逆的」。

items.en: Middle English joined awk, backhanded, with -ward to make awkeward, in the wrong direction.
items.cn: 中古英语把 awk「用反手的」与 -ward 合成 awkeward「方向不对」。

items.en: The d was later added by analogy with backward.
items.cn: 后仿 backward 的形式补入字母 d。

items.en: The sense widened from wrong direction to clumsy, then to embarrassing.
items.cn: 词义从「方向不对」扩大为「笨拙」，再至「尴尬」。

items.en: Today the social sense dominates, especially of silences and situations.
items.cn: 现代英语以社交义为主，多形容沉默与处境。

note.en: Group one holds the backward-root family and look-alikes; group two holds the discomfort field.
note.cn: 第一组收「朝后」词根词族与形近词；第二组收「不自在」义场。

entries.definition: toward the rear; the -ward pattern awkward imitates.
entries.definitionCN: 向后的；awkward 仿效的 -ward 构词。

entries.definition: covered with water; only the initial aw- misleads.
entries.definitionCN: 被水覆盖的；仅开头 aw- 相近，词源无关。

entries.definition: a prize; shares no root with awkward.
entries.definitionCN: 奖品；与 awkward 无同源关系。

normalIntro.en: awkward is Old Norse afugr plus -ward: turned toward the wrong way.
normalIntro.cn: awkward 即古诺斯语 afugr 加 -ward：朝错误方向转去。

normal.en: The d was added by analogy with backward.
normal.cn: 字母 d 仿 backward 补入。

normal.en: Noun: awkwardness, the state of being ill at ease.
normal.cn: 名词 awkwardness：不自在的状态。

normal.en: Phrase: the awkward squad, misfits in the ranks.
normal.cn: 短语 the awkward squad：队列里的刺头。

abstract.en: See your hands forgetting where to rest.
abstract.cn: 想象双手不知该放在哪。

abstract.en: Awkward is a body facing the wrong direction of the room.
abstract.cn: awkward 是身体朝向房间错误方向的姿态。

abstract.en: Hear the silence stretch after the wrong joke.
abstract.cn: 听错笑话之后被拉长的沉默。

examples.en: He felt awkward asking strangers for directions.
examples.cn: 向陌生人问路让他觉得别扭。

examples.en: The key turned with an awkward, grinding motion.
examples.cn: 钥匙转动起来又涩又费劲。

examples.en: They asked several awkward questions about the budget.
examples.cn: 他们就预算提出了几个难答的问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥克沃德」——像 oak（橡木）做的木头人，动作僵硬又尴尬

root: 出自古诺斯语 afugr「朝后的、反转的」加英语后缀 -ward「朝……方向」，本义「方向朝后」；后引申为「笨拙」与「尴尬」。词中字母 d 为仿 backward 类推而加。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses unfold from one wrong turning: embarrassing scenes, clumsy limbs, ill-shaped tools, difficult people, self-conscious feelings, bad timings, misfits, and the adverb.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项由一次「转错方向」展开：尴尬场面、笨拙肢体、难用工具、难缠人物、局促心情、不巧时机、不合群者，以及副词形态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body or thing turned the wrong way.
core.cn: 核心意象：朝错误方向拧转的身与物。

branches.en: Limbs that turn the wrong way move clumsily.
branches.cn: 转错方向的肢体，动作便笨拙。

branches.en: Things and times turned the wrong way become inconvenient.
branches.cn: 转错方向的物与时，便成不便。

branches.en: When the wrong turning is visible, embarrassment follows.
branches.cn: 「转错」被人看见，尴尬随之而来。

branches.en: A person the system cannot fit is hard to handle.
branches.cn: 安放不进系统的人，难以对付。

branches.en: The misfit in line and the adverb of manner close the chain.
branches.cn: 队中的不合群者与副词形态收束全链。

intro.en: Awkward is built on a Norse root with an English directional suffix; its family shows how a bodily image grows into social meaning.
intro.cn: awkward 以诺斯语词根配英语方向后缀；其词族展示了身体意象如何长出社交意义。

latinIntro.en: No Latin kin exists; the line runs through Old Norse, so the Latin table stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同源词，词线出自古诺斯语，拉丁同族表留空。
